sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
Mr. Srikanta Panda advocate and associates have entered appearance on behalf of the informant by filing Vakalatnama.
The same be kept on record.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
4.

The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Bhubaneswar Mahila P.S. Case No. 177 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No. 1800 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhubaneswar for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 493/417/420/323/323/506/34 of IPC.
5.
It appears that the main allegation is against one Laxmikant Mohanty@Neel with whom the informant had relationship since August, 2020.
In so far as the petitioner is concerned, he is the brother-in-law of said Laxmikant Mohanty and had assured the informant to get her married to Laxmikant.
He is further said to have taken Rs.1,50,000/- from the informant, but she admits in her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. that said amount has been refunded.
There is no other allegation against the present petitioner.
6. Having regard to the nature of accusations and the materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified Sanjaya Kumar vs State Of Odisha ....
